name: Divine Judgment (Gestalt)
body:
Your faith allows you to pronounce judgment on your foes.

Prerequisite: You have no levels in a class that has the judgment class feature.

Benefit: You gain the ability to use a single judgment from the inquisitor judgment class feature. You can use this judgment once per day, and it lasts for one minute or until combat ends, whichever comes first. For purposes of using that judgment, treat your inquisitor level as equal to your character level – 2.

Special: If you gain levels in a class that grants the judgment class feature, you can immediately trade this feat for either the Instant Judgment or Judgment Surge feat.
